assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent game-mascot intensity expression for a Japanese listening app, displayed at about 80 pixels.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the exact existing Kiku orange cat wearing purple over-ear headphones.
Primary request: Create the MODERATE intensity version of this exact mascot. Kiku is clearly awake and focused: upright attentive seated posture, noticeably larger round open eyes with small bright highlights, gently raised eyebrows, a small confident open smile. Both front paws stay resting in front. The expression is alert and engaged, more attentive than a relaxed small-eyed cat but not wildly excited or angry. Change facial expression and subtle posture only.
Composition: one whole centered mascot on a square canvas, same visual scale and framing as the reference. Keep the complete headphone arch, ears, paws and curled tail visible with a small clear transparent margin. Simple bold shapes must remain recognizable at 80 pixels.
Invariants: preserve Kiku's identity, golden-orange fur, pink inner ears, purple nose, purple over-ear headphones, thick dark-purple outlines, soft existing cel shading, round head, compact seated body proportions and curled tail. Preserve the illustration style closely; not a different cat.
Background: genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the mascot and inside headphone arch. Cat and headphones only.
Avoid: labels, text, colored backdrops, fake checkerboard, cast shadows, additional objects, loose stars or sound marks, new accessories, extra limbs, other cats, dramatic lighting or photorealism. Intensity background colors will be supplied by the UI.
assets.visualReview: Inspected: upright attentive cat, large open highlighted eyes and small open smile; both paws resting. Same orange/purple palette, headphones and bold outlines; genuine transparent alpha.
assets.processing: Original generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits, resizing or alpha changes.
